analysis: The PR changes only CHANGELOG.md (patch at lines 6-12 adds an 'Unreleased - KV admission estimates' entry; no code, config or threat-model files). It is documentation only, so no executable security behavior changes. The entry describes provider memory/KV admission tuning: engine concurrency reduced when fixed recurrent/MTP workspace would consume the KV grant; cold-model KV cost estimated from fresh native reports for the same artifact and verified runtime; cold-rate evidence shared once per fleet sample; registry read leases not held across donor walks. Relevant threat IDs: T-016, T-029 and TB-007 (resource availability, provider memory checks) and TB-002/TB-009 (provider-reported telemetry is untrusted and could be forged by an adversarial provider). The changelog states live slot budgets stay authoritative and provider memory checks still decide fit, activation and minimum-KV safeguards are not lowered. It also says missing evidence retains the generic fallback. No claim here alters authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or App Attest gating. The next pass should check any accompanying code, if present in other batches, for: (1) whether provider-reported native reports used for KV estimates are bound to the artifact and verified runtime and cannot be forged to skew routing; (2) whether the fleet-sample shared cold-rate evidence changes lock ordering or registry read lease behavior; (3) whether heartbeat-reported memory-limited concurrency feeds public billing or settlement. These cannot be assessed from this changelog alone, so no findings are raised. The threat model needs no update from this PR.
